filters.description: List of filters to determine which po file entries should be retained. Valid values: t, nt, nth, f, nf, o, no.

excluded_parts.description: List of parts to exclude from output. Valid values: ctxt, id, str, tr, ucmt, pcmt, scmt, dcmt, cmt, linf.

show_count.description: If true, display only the count of entries instead of the entries themselves (-s).

preserve_formatting.description: If true, keep the formatting of the file intact and do not re-wrap strings (-p).

overwrite_translations.description: If true, overwrite all msgstrs with their msgids (-c).

working_copy.description: The working copy PO file (FILENAME2) for replacement mode. Leave empty for filter mode.
